statement_en: Is it true that, for all sufficiently large $n$, there exists some $i<n$ such that\[p_n^2 < p_{n+i}p_{n-i},\]where $p_k$ is the $k$th prime?

def EventuallyHasPrimeWitness : Prop :=
  ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n →
    ∃ i : ℕ, i < n ∧
      (Nat.nth Nat.Prime n) ^ (2 : ℕ) <
        Nat.nth Nat.Prime (n + i) * Nat.nth Nat.Prime (n - i)
